description: Finds Google Sheets spreadsheets the authorized user can open (own files and shared drives; trashed files are excluded): id, name, createdTime, modifiedTime, owners and webViewLink per file, newest-modified first by default. name_contains filters by name substring; omit it to list everything. Paginate with page_token from nextPageToken. This is the one read that goes through the Drive API internally, so the OAuth token needs a Drive scope (drive, drive.readonly or drive.file for app-created files) — with only the spreadsheets scope it fails with 403 while every other tool still works.

name_contains.description: Case-insensitive name substring to filter by (omit to list all spreadsheets).

order_by.description: Drive sort key, e.g. "modifiedTime desc" (default), "name", "createdTime desc", "viewedByMeTime desc".

name: search_spreadsheets
title: Search spreadsheets
